patch.value: The pinned pm-cli is a version behind the fleet, so the prepare script strips two merge-fence rules from .gitattributes on every install

package-lock pins @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.6 while every other fleet repository resolves 2026.8.7. The prepare script runs pm merge install, and 2026.8.6 writes a merge-driver fence without the two rules covering .agents/pm/extensions. The committed .gitattributes on main carries those rules, so any install or release check leaves the working tree dirty with their removal, and committing that removal would drop the fence that keeps extension state from being line-merged between agents. Seven of eight sampled fleet repositories carry the fence; pm-context is the other outlier at zero.

value.author: codex
value.text: Deliberately not fixed inside the coverage PR. Bumping the pinned CLI changes the pm binary CI runs, and history_drift verdicts are known to differ between pm versions, so a dependency bump carried inside a coverage change can turn a green gate red for a reason unrelated to the change under review. It needs its own PR where a drift difference is the expected outcome rather than a surprise.
